# README banner

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI: 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 4068628254, then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG. The same prompt and seed give the same picture.

Prompt:

> a giant evergreen pine tree whose branches hold glowing scrolls and small tools, a gardener robot gently pruning it, misty forest, wide cinematic banner illustration, painterly digital art, soft volumetric light, rich but muted colour palette, detailed, storybook atmosphere, no text, no letters, no words, no logos, no watermark

# Social preview

`social-preview.jpg` is the repository's social preview (the card shown when a link to the repository is shared). It uses the same prompt and seed with the same settings at 1536x768, resized to 1280x640 (GitHub's recommended 2:1 size) and saved as JPEG. It was picked from six renders (this prompt with seeds 4068628254, 1111, 2222 and 3333, and a variant prompt adding fresh green shoots with seeds 4068628254 and 4444) because the tree sits in the centre and the robot and scrolls stay readable at thumbnail size, and the shared seed keeps it close to the README banner. GitHub takes the social preview only through the repository's Settings page, so the file here is the copy to upload there.
